shared_elements: horizontal registers/bands stacked one above another
row of repeated arch-like or loop-shaped motifs along the top
band of repeated angular zigzag/chevron or hatched elements
row of repeated pendant/vertical tapering motifs
justification: The most specific correspondence is the shared vertical sequence of registers: an upper row of repeated arch/loop shapes, beneath it a band of repeated pendant or hatched vertical strokes, and then a zigzag/chevron band, all cut in flat, shallow relief on pale stone. The biggest differences are format and content — A is a horizontal panel framed by an interlace border and dominated by purely geometric repetition, while B is a vertical free-standing pillar whose lower two-thirds carries naturalistic animals (quadrupeds, a long-necked bird) and a plant-like motif that have no counterpart in A.
